text_en: Now the Reubenites and the Gadites owned a very great number of cattle. When they saw that the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead was a good place for cattle,
text_cn: 勒乌本的子孙和加得的子孙，拥有很多的家畜；他们一见雅则尔地方和基肋阿得地方，是适于畜牧的区域，

text_en: the Gadites and the Reubenites came and spoke to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
text_cn: 便前来对梅瑟和厄肋阿匝尔大司祭及会众的首领说：

text_en: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon—
text_cn: “阿塔洛特、狄朋、雅则尔、尼默辣、赫市朋、厄肋阿肋、色班、乃波和贝红，

text_en: the land that the Lord subdued before the congregation of Israel—is a land for cattle; and your servants have cattle. ”
text_cn: 这些地方是上主为以色列会众所征服的，是适于畜牧的地方，而你的仆人们正有牛羊。”

text_en: They continued, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; do not make us cross the Jordan. ”
text_cn: 他们又说：“若是我们在你眼中获得宠幸，希望你将这地方赐给你的仆人们作产业，不必叫我们过约但河。”

text_en: But Moses said to the Gadites and to the Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
text_cn: 梅瑟回答加得的子孙和勒乌本的子孙说：“怎么！你们的兄弟去打仗，你们却要住在这里？

text_en: Why will you discourage the hearts of the Israelites from going over into the land that the Lord has given them?
text_cn: 为什么你们要叫以色列子民丧气，使他们不敢进入上主赐给他们的土地？

text_en: Your fathers did this, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
text_cn: 当我由卡德士巴尔乃亚派遣你们的祖先去窥探这地时，他们也这样做过。

text_en: When they went up to the Wadi Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the hearts of the Israelites from going into the land that the Lord had given them.
text_cn: 他们上到厄市苛耳山谷，窥探了那地方，回来就使以色列子民丧了气，致使他们再不愿进入上主赐给他们的土地。

text_en: The Lord ’s anger was kindled on that day and he swore, saying,
text_cn: 为此上主在那天发怒起誓说：

text_en: ‘Surely none of the people who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land that I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because they have not unreservedly followed me—
text_cn: ‘凡由埃及出来过了二十岁的人，不得看见我誓许给亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的土地，因为他们没有一心一意地随从我；

text_en: none except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they have unreservedly followed the Lord . ’
text_cn: 只有刻纳次人耶孚乃的儿子加肋布和农的儿子若苏厄除外，因为他们一心一意地随从了上主。’

text_en: And the Lord ’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the sight of the Lord had disappeared.
text_cn: 因为上主对以色列发了怒，遂使他们在旷野中漂泊了四十年，直到在上主眼前作恶的那一世代完全死尽。

text_en: And now you, a brood of sinners, have risen in place of your fathers, to increase the Lord ’s fierce anger against Israel!
text_cn: 现在，看，你们这些罪人的苗裔，竟起来替代你们先人，再增加上主对以色列的忿怒！

text_en: If you turn away from following him, he will again abandon them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all this people. ”
text_cn: 如果你们背离了他，他再把民众抛在旷野里；这样，你们就要使这整个民族毁灭了。”

text_en: Then they came up to him and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our flocks, and towns for our little ones,
text_cn: 他们遂上前来，对他说：“我们愿在这里为我们的牛羊筑圈，为我们的家眷建城。

text_en: but we will take up arms as a vanguard before the Israelites, until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our little ones will stay in the fortified towns because of the inhabitants of the land.
text_cn: 但我们必武装起来，在以色列子民前头上阵，直到我们领他们进入了自己的地方；至于我们的家眷，为预防本地的居民，应叫他们安居在坚固的城内。

text_en: We will not return to our homes until all the Israelites have obtained their inheritance.
text_cn: 不到以色列子民各个都占有了产业，我们决不回家。

text_en: We will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan to the east. ”
text_cn: 我们既然在约但河东得到了产业，在约但河西，就不再同他们分产业了。”

text_en: So Moses said to them, “If you do this—if you take up arms to go before the Lord for the war,
text_cn: 梅瑟答复他们说：“若是你们这样做，若是你们武装起来，在上主面前作战；

text_en: and all those of you who bear arms cross the Jordan before the Lord , until he has driven out his enemies from before him
text_cn: 若是你们个个都武装着在上主面前过约但河，直到他将自己的敌人驱散，

text_en: and the land is subdued before the Lord —then after that you may return and be free of obligation to the Lord and to Israel, and this land shall be your possession before the Lord .
text_cn: 直到上主把那地征服以后，你们才回家，你们对上主，对以色列就算无罪。那么，这地照上主的允许，归你们作为产业。

text_en: But if you do not do this, you have sinned against the Lord ; and be sure your sin will find you out.
text_cn: 但是，如果你们不这样去做，你们必获罪于上主，要知道你们必自招罪罚。

text_en: Build towns for your little ones, and folds for your flocks; but do what you have promised. ”
text_cn: 你们可为家眷建城，为牛羊筑圈；但是你们口头所许的，却必要实践。”

text_en: Then the Gadites and the Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
text_cn: 加得的子孙和勒乌本的子孙回答梅瑟说：“你仆人们必照我主所吩咐的去做。

text_en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall remain there in the towns of Gilead;
text_cn: 我们的孩童、妇女、牛羊和一切牲畜，都留在这里，留在基肋阿得的城里；

text_en: but your servants will cross over, everyone armed for war, to do battle for the Lord , just as my lord orders. ”
text_cn: 至于你的仆人们，凡武装起来的，都要过河，在上主面前上阵作战，如我主所吩咐的。”

text_en: So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the heads of the ancestral houses of the Israelite tribes.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂为他们向大司祭厄肋阿匝尔、农的儿子若苏厄，以及以色列子民各支派的家长下了指示，

text_en: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and the Reubenites, everyone armed for battle before the Lord , will cross over the Jordan with you and the land shall be subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
text_cn: 向他们说：“若是加得子孙和勒乌本子孙，都武装起来与你们同过约但河，在上主面前作战，在你们征服那地以后，就把基肋阿得地方给他们作为产业。

text_en: but if they will not cross over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan. ”
text_cn: 但是，如果他们不武装起来同你们一起过河，就应在客纳罕地与你们同分产业。”

text_en: The Gadites and the Reubenites answered, “As the Lord has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
text_cn: 加得子孙和勒乌本子孙回答说：“凡上主关于你仆人所说的，我们必照做。

text_en: We will cross over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, but the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us on this side of the Jordan. ”
text_cn: 我们必武装起来在上主面前过河，往客纳罕地去；但约但河东的地方应给我们作产业。”

text_en: Moses gave to them—to the Gadites and to the Reubenites and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph—the kingdom of King Sihon of the Amorites and the kingdom of King Og of Bashan, the land and its towns, with the territories of the surrounding towns.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂将阿摩黎人王息红的国土和巴商王敖格的国土，那地域及其境内的城池，以及那地域四周的城池，都给了他们；给了加得的子孙、勒乌本的子孙和若瑟的儿子默纳协半支派。

text_en: And the Gadites rebuilt Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
text_cn: 加得的子孙重建了狄朋、阿塔洛特、阿洛厄尔、

text_en: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
text_cn: 阿特洛特芍番、雅则尔、约革波哈、

text_en: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
text_cn: 贝特尼默辣和贝特哈兰：这些都是坚固的城邑，并筑有羊圈。

text_en: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
text_cn: 勒乌本的子孙重建了赫市朋、厄肋阿肋、克黎雅塔因、

text_en: Nebo, and Baal-meon (some names being changed), and Sibmah; and they gave names to the towns that they rebuilt.
text_cn: 乃波、巴耳默红──有些名字已改──和息贝玛；他们给重建的城邑另起了别名。

text_en: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were there;
text_cn: 默纳协的儿子玛基尔的子孙去了基肋阿得，占据了那地方，驱逐了那里的阿摩黎人。

text_en: so Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he settled there.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂将基肋阿得给了默纳协的儿子玛基尔；他就在那里住下了。

text_en: Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages, and renamed them Havvoth-jair.
text_cn: 默纳协的儿子雅依尔去占据了阿摩黎人的村落，遂称这些村落为哈沃特雅依尔。

text_en: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages, and renamed it Nobah after himself.
text_cn: 诺巴黑去占据了刻纳特及其属镇，给那地方起了自己的名字，叫诺巴黑。
